messages:
Eleni: Wanted to loop folks on a keyboard-first pass for the autoscale controls. Main goals: fully operable without mouse, clear visual guardrail language (icons + color), and minimal surprises when presets are applied. Prototype: https://intranet.redwood/protos/autoscale-keyboard-first :keyboard:

Marco: Nice. First cut feedback: make sure every interactive element has a visible focus ring that’s at least 3px and high contrast. The SLO slider ticks need to be tabbable with `role=slider` and expose `aria-valuenow`/`aria-valuetext` for screen readers.

Yara: UX on guardrails: propose three visual treatments: 1) soft badge (info) for non-blocking suggestions, 2) amber triangle for warning guardrails (reduced capacity + burst disabled), 3) red stop icon for hard blocks (can't save). Icons should have text alternatives and not rely on color alone.

Maya: Agree on three-tier visual grammar. Also want small inline copy changes: instead of "Max cap", use "Maximum allowed replicas" in the tooltip. Keep short label on screen but full label in the tooltip/aria-label.

Eleni: Keyboard flows I'm proposing: focus lands on pool picker -> press Enter to open -> Arrow keys to navigate -> Tab moves to min stepper -> arrow keys to adjust -> Tab to max -> Tab to SLO presets -> Enter to apply -> toast with Undo. Presets must be undoable via keyboard (toast focusable).

Marco: Telemetry/dev note: When presets change multiple guardrails we should emit a single event with a list of diffs. Example event snippet: `track('autoscale.preset.apply', {preset: 'cost-saving', diffs: ['burst:disabled','max:reduced:50']})`. Make sure we debounce preset analytics so we don't spam on rapid toggles.

Yara: Accessibility nit: when preset applies and it changes burst state, screen readers should announce: "Cost-saving applied. Burst disabled. Maximum reduced to 50 replicas." Use `role=\"status\" aria-live=\"polite\"`. Also ensure the burst toggle has `aria-pressed` so state is clear to assistive tech.

Maya: Visual hint: for warning guardrails show an inline help link "Why is this limited?" that opens a small panel with reason + link to docs. For a11y, the link should have `aria-controls` to the help panel id so users know context.

Eleni: Edge case: if a user types a max below min, we need inline validation messaging and keyboard focus should move to the offending field with `aria-invalid=true` and `aria-describedby` pointing to the error text. Also show an inline suggestion to swap values.

Marco: For mouse users we can keep micro-interactions (hover tooltips, popovers), but ensure they are duplicated on focus. Tooltips should not be the only way to access critical copy.

DevBot: Deploy-note: feature-flag `autoscale_keyboard_v2` will gate the behavior. Staging rollout 25% on Monday. Add e2e that verifies tab sequence and aria attributes.

Yara: One more on color contrast: the amber triangle on small icons fails AA at 12px. Either increase size to 16px or add a 1px stroke. I'll attach a small color test screenshot later.

Eleni: Thanks everyone. Plan: I'll update Figma to include the three-tier icons, keyboard flow annotations, and the tooltip/aria labels. Marco, can you add the telemetry event in the analytics spec? DevBot: please add the feature flag and e2e tasks. If no objections I'll merge the PR with these notes by EOD. :rocket:
